agencyName: Florida Construction Industry Licensing Board (Rule 61G4-15.001, F.A.C.)
authorityRationale: Rule 61G4-15.001, F.A.C., 'Qualification for Certification' (effective 5/16/2024), CILB's own rule on flrules.org. Read directly 2026-10-09 from the rule .doc: certification categories include 'Sheet Metal; Class A and B Air Conditioning' and 'Plumbing Classification', with experience 'gained under the supervision of a contractor' (contractor certification under ch. 489, F.S.).
reliabilityRationale: Official primary document from the licensing agency itself, verified by direct read on 2026-10-09.
